description.en: Rank a stock universe with transparent QVeris factor evidence across valuation, quality, liquidity, momentum, and news risk.
description.zh: 用 QVeris 因子证据对股票池按质量、动量、估值、流动性、波动和新闻风险进行透明排序。

overview.en: Use this skill when a user asks an agent to screen many stocks, build a candidate universe, or explain factor-driven rankings. It does not train a model; it builds a transparent factor table from live QVeris calls and highlights missing data.
overview.zh: 当用户让 Agent 筛选多只股票、建立候选池或解释因子排序时使用。它不训练模型，而是用 QVeris 实时调用构建透明因子表，并标注缺失数据。

description.en: Rank a theme universe by transparent factors.
description.zh: 按透明因子排序主题股票池。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to screen a bounded AI infrastructure watchlist such as AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMD, and AVGO by valuation, quality, liquidity, momentum, and news risk. Return ranks, missing data, factor weights, QVeris calls used, and estimated credits. For 50-stock screens, require an explicit large budget before live execution.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 按估值、质量、流动性、动量和新闻风险筛选有界 AI 基建观察列表，例如 AAPL、MSFT、NVDA、AMD、AVGO。返回排序、缺失数据、因子权重、QVeris 调用和预计 credits。若要筛选 50 只股票，live 执行前必须获得明确的大额预算授权。

description.zh: 建立 A 股候选名单。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to screen A-share semiconductor equipment stocks. Rank by growth, profitability, balance-sheet quality, liquidity, valuation, and recent catalysts.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 筛选 A 股半导体设备公司。按成长、盈利能力、资产负债质量、流动性、估值和近期催化排序。

description.en: Explain why a name ranked high or low.
description.zh: 解释某只股票排序高或低的原因。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to audit why this stock ranks high in a factor screen. Show the raw factor evidence, missing fields, and which factor dominates the score.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 审计这只股票为何在因子筛选中排名靠前。展示原始因子证据、缺失字段和主导分数的因子。

description.en: Turn structured financial data into callable agent capabilities.
description.zh: 把结构化金融数据变成 Agent 可调用能力。

description.en: Add market data coverage for global research and screening workflows.
description.zh: 为全球研究和筛选工作流补充市场数据覆盖。

description.en: A practical workflow for source-backed A-share monitoring.
description.zh: 面向 A 股监控和来源证据研究的实用工作流。

purpose.en: Find quote, OHLCV, fundamentals, valuation, financial statements, news, and liquidity capabilities.
purpose.zh: 寻找行情、OHLCV、基本面、估值、财务报表、新闻和流动性能力。

qveris_api.sample_query: stock factor screening fundamentals OHLCV valuation liquidity API

purpose.en: Check how many tickers each provider covers and estimate cost before batch calls.
purpose.zh: 检查每个供应商覆盖多少股票，并在批量调用前估算成本。

purpose.en: Call selected inputs, normalize factors, and return ranks with missing-data warnings.
purpose.zh: 调用选定输入，标准化因子，并返回带缺失数据提示的排序。

summary.en: This workflow usually needs 10-40 paid Calls after free Discover and Inspect preflight for bounded watchlists. Large 50-stock screens require explicit higher paid-call and credit budgets. Cost depends on providers, ticker count, and time window.
summary.zh: 有界观察列表通常在免费 Discover 和 Inspect 预检后需要 10-40 次付费 Call。50 只股票的大范围筛选需要明确提高付费调用和 credit 预算。费用取决于供应商、股票数量和时间窗口。

note.en: Ask for explicit approval before paid Calls. Inspect billing_rule for every selected capability and reduce scope if the estimate is too high.
note.zh: 付费 Call 前必须获得明确确认。检查每个选定能力的 billing_rule；如果预计成本过高，先缩小范围。

evidence.en: Updated from QVeris Discover / Inspect preflight on 2026-07-02; live smoke traces are stored under artifacts after execution.
evidence.zh: 已根据 2026-07-02 的 QVeris Discover / Inspect 预检更新；live smoke trace 会在执行后保存到 artifacts。

description.en: Set market, theme, tickers, factor set, weights, and maximum paid calls.
description.zh: 设定市场、主题、股票、因子、权重和最大付费调用数。

description.en: Use QVeris Inspect to see coverage and billing before broad execution.
description.zh: 用 QVeris Inspect 在大范围执行前查看覆盖和计费。

description.en: Call bounded data, normalize comparable fields, and mark missing data.
description.zh: 调用限定数据，标准化可比字段，并标注缺失数据。

description.en: Return ranks, factor drivers, outliers, and next verification steps.
description.zh: 返回排序、因子驱动、异常值和下一步验证。

status_note.en: Preview until hosted Skill Hub validation and release approval are complete. Deterministic scripts, fixture tests, QVeris live smoke traces, Codex validation, and local OpenClaw validation have been exercised.
status_note.zh: 预览状态：已完成确定性脚本、fixture 测试、QVeris live smoke trace、Codex 验证和本地 OpenClaw 验证；Hosted Skill Hub 验证和发布审批完成前不得标记为上线。
